title: Rotary knob
description: What the knob controls and how. Light channel changes apply after a restart, everything else at once. Manual: https://github.com/BoatHacks/signalk-rotary-knob/blob/main/docs/manual.md

keys.name: allow_control
keys.title: Allow control
keys.description: Autopilot and anchor commands leave the knob only while this is on. Off on a fresh knob and after a factory reset. Switching it on here shows CONTROL ON on the knob.

keys.name: demo
keys.title: Demo mode
keys.description: Simulated boat, no SignalK traffic at all, nothing is ever sent. Wi-Fi and this page stay up. The knob restarts when this changes.

keys.name: demo_auto
keys.title: Automatic demo
keys.description: With demo mode on: the knob runs a scripted tour of every mode by itself and shows each turn, press and touch on the screen. Any real input pauses it, it starts again after a minute without input.

keys.name: autopilot_id
keys.title: Autopilot id
keys.description: The autopilot in the SignalK v2 autopilot API, the id after /autopilots/ (not _default on this boat).

keys.name: heading_source
keys.title: Heading source
keys.description: navigation.headingTrue (shown as degrees true) or navigation.headingMagnetic (degrees magnetic).

keys.name: anchor_radius
keys.title: Default anchor radius
keys.description: The watch circle radius used when arming, until the dial changes it.

keys.name: dim_after_s
keys.title: Dim after idle
keys.description: Seconds without input before the backlight drops to the dim level.

keys.name: dim_level_pct
keys.title: Dim level
keys.description: Backlight when dimmed. 10 % can be hard to read in direct sun.

keys.name: off_after_min
keys.title: Backlight off after idle
keys.description: Minutes of idle before the backlight goes fully off, except while the autopilot is engaged or an alarm is active. 0 = never.

keys.name: brightness_pct
keys.title: Active brightness
keys.description: Backlight while in use. The knob's settings screen changes it too.

keys.name: night_mode
keys.title: Night mode
keys.description: server = follow environment.mode from SignalK, day or night = fixed. The serial command n overrides it until the next restart.

keys.name: leds_on
keys.title: LEDs
keys.description: Off = every LED stays dark in every mode, the alarm flash included: an alarm then shows on the screen only.

keys.name: hid_profile
keys.title: USB-HID profile
keys.description: What the dial does in the USB-HID mode: chartplotter (mouse wheel and click), media (volume and mute) or nav (arrow keys and enter).

keys.name: music_mode
keys.title: MUSIC mode
keys.description: Show the MUSIC mode on the mode ring: the boat's music through the signalk-jukebox plugin.

keys.name: motor_mode
keys.title: MOTOR mode
keys.description: Show the MOTOR mode on the mode ring: the throttle of a motor that takes a SignalK PUT. Off unless the boat has a motor controller made for it. Throttle commands also need allow control. Manual: motor section.

keys.name: motor_id
keys.title: Motor id
keys.description: The motor's id in propulsion.<id>: the throttle goes to propulsion.<id>.throttle (PUT, -1 to 1), the gear, revolutions and engineTorque are read from there. Applies after a restart.

keys.name: motor_power
keys.title: Motor power path
keys.description: A SignalK path with the motor's power draw in watts, from the motor or a battery monitor. Empty: the screen shows no power. Applies after a restart.

keys.name: motor_curve
keys.title: Throttle steps
keys.description: Percent per click for slow, normal and fast turning: gentle 1/1/2, normal 1/2/5, quick 1/3/10.

keys.name: motor_ahead
keys.title: Throttle limit ahead
keys.description: The throttle stops here and warns. A double press lifts both limits until the knob is disarmed.

keys.name: motor_astern
keys.title: Throttle limit astern
keys.description: As the limit ahead, for astern.

keys.name: motor_idle_s
keys.title: Motor disarm when idle
keys.description: Armed in neutral without input, the knob gives up control after this long. 0 never, otherwise 10 to 300 s. Out of neutral it never does.

keys.name: light1_name
keys.title: Light 1 name
keys.description: Shown on the knob, upper case, up to 15 characters.

keys.name: light1_path
keys.title: Light 1 SignalK path
keys.description: Empty = channel not used. A relay path takes 1 or 0, a dimmer path a ratio 0 to 1.

keys.name: light1_form
keys.title: Light 1 type
keys.description: onoff = a relay (turn right is on, left is off). level = a dimmer.
